depends_on: L1_GENERIC_EXACT broad transfer: 5/5 non-control layouts passed
cache_rule: For each exact QR program, propagate candidate-dependent state-word set. Candidate-independent QR outputs are precomputed once per target and copied into the per-candidate state at the same execution point; candidate-dependent QRs execute normally. No QR is classified fixed if its input group intersects the propagated dependency set.

exactness_gate.required: all cached predicates and survivor/direct sets exactly equal generic reference

wall_benchmark.timed_scope: target output construction + layout-specific fixed-cache construction + full 1024-candidate screen/direct loops; same logical-key patch helper in both algorithms
wall_benchmark.order: alternate algorithm and baseline per target; report median

family_wall_interpretation.broad_wall_transfer: at least 4 of 5 non-control layouts pass both wall gates
family_wall_interpretation.qr_only_transfer: 0 or 1 pass; retain QR transfer but do not broaden wall-time claim

claim_limit: Wall results can broaden only the constant-factor engineering claim. Leading candidate enumeration remains 2^b and alpha=1. No full-round claim.
forbidden: No repeat count, target, layout, split, word, width, cache classification or benchmark scope changes after wall results.
